title: SemantiK Pedagogical Lexicon
description: Profile-organized vocabulary of pedagogical opener labels, end-of-chapter apparatus section names, and OCR-confusable normalizations consumed by the SemantiK adapter seam (lib/semantik/opener_classifier.py, lib/semantik/heading_classifier.py, and the marker-normalization pass in lib/semantik/adapter.py). Wave #22 (tiers 1-2 semantic enrichment) lifted these vocabularies out of hardcoded Python constants so a NEW corpus is onboarded by adding a PROFILE / label entry here, never by editing code (the owner's directive 3: lexicon profiles, not corpus-specific code). Profile selection is env-driven via SEMANTIK_LEXICON_PROFILE (default 'generic-academic+openstax'): a '+'-joined list of profile keys merged left-to-right, the later profile OVERLAYING the earlier one.
$comment: Vocabularies lifted verbatim (behavior-preserving refactor) from: opener_classifier._OPENERS + _INTERIOR_OPENERS (the six promotable openers and the three interior-split-capable numbered ones); heading_classifier.APPARATUS_HEADING_NAMES (standalone + leading-split apparatus section headings), _INTERIOR_APPARATUS_NAMES (the ALL-CAPS interior-banner subset), and _APPARATUS_WHITELIST (short-heading demotion whitelist); and adapter._CONFUSABLE_TRYIT_RE (the trvit->TRY IT OCR-confusable). The abstract 'association_role' on each opener is the Wave #22 Tier-2 composite-unit vocabulary (worked_example example/solution/practice, procedure, section_opener objectives/readiness) the adapter's _associate_composite_units pass keys on; it maps each concrete opener role slug to the abstract role the association rules are expressed over. label 'pattern' values are regex BODY fragments (word-internal whitespace is \s+): the classifiers wrap them with the shared gutter / number / anchor scaffolding (opener_classifier._GUTTER / _NUM), so a pattern is corpus VOCAB only, never structural regex.

generic-academic.description: Default academic-textbook vocabulary (Example / Solution / How To openers, the Key-Terms-class end-of-chapter apparatus sections, and the short-heading whitelist). Corpus-agnostic: the labels a mathematics / science / humanities textbook uses regardless of publisher.

openstax.description: OpenStax-specific overlay: the TRY IT (practice) / BE PREPARED (readiness) numbered openers, and the trvit->TRY IT OCR-confusable the sample-algebra scan corpus emits. Overlays the generic-academic profile without displacing it.
